content:
1) “Inbox and calendar triage—sorting emails, drafting replies, scheduling meetings, and chasing follow-ups.”

2) “Research and summarization—reading long reports, extracting key points, comparing options, and producing concise briefs.”

3) “Data cleanup and reporting—merging spreadsheets, deduping records, formatting data, and generating weekly KPI dashboards.”

4) “Documentation and admin—updating SOPs, writing meeting notes, logging decisions, and keeping project trackers current.”

5) “Repetitive content production—turning outlines into first drafts, repurposing content across channels, and creating variants for A/B tests.”
